---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem without disclosing private desktop data
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Expected behaviour

What should have happened?

## Actual behaviour

What happened, and did the problem affect input, video, permission status or recovery?

## Steps to reproduce

Use a disposable or non-sensitive test case. Include only the minimum steps.

## Environment

Windows version, Node.js version, component, LG model (if relevant) and product source version.

## Safety and recovery

Could you stop the action? Did any files or settings change unexpectedly? Was a duplicate action possible?

## Checks run

Which non-destructive tests were run and what was the result?

**Privacy:** Never paste pairing keys, session URLs, private transcripts, unredacted desktop screenshots or logs containing credentials.
